No — as a Chinese passport holder you cannot use visa on arrival (VOA) for Vietnam. Chinese nationals don't have visa-free access and are specifically excluded from the VOA program.

What you should do instead: apply for an e-Visa at https://evisa.gov.vn/. It's available to all nationalities (including China), covers stays of up to 90 days — well within your 10-day trip — costs USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), and processing takes about 2-3 business days (expedited options exist for a higher fee). It's valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved e-Visa ports.

A couple of practical notes: make sure your passport is valid for at least 180 days from your entry date, and double-check the current e-Visa port list and requirements on evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since entry-port details can change. This information is current as of 2026-08-17 per the bundled policy data — worth a final check on the official site closer to your travel date.
